entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Thanks for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your name and ID again?
Of course. My name is Sarah, ID 303. I can definitely help with that. To start, may I have your name and order number?
Mark Peterson, order number is VF88-125. Look, I don't have time for a long call. It's broken, I want to return it. Yes or no?
I understand you're busy, Mr. Peterson. I just need to ask one quick clarifying question. When you say it's broken, is it a technical fault or just not meeting your expectations?
It's defective. The heart rate is all over the place, and the main reason I bought it was for tracking, but it won't sync with my phone anymore. It's just not working.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I'm sorry to hear you received a defective unit. Let me just pull up your delivery date... I see it was delivered on December 15th, which was 24 days ago.
Let me check our return policy for you... one moment... Okay, I see here that you are well within our 90-day return window.
Good. So you can process the return?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the item up and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse scans it, a full refund will be processed.
Alright. That's what I needed. Thank you.

You're very welcome. And Mr. Peterson, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience of receiving a faulty product, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. My apologies again.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
